description: List a page of non-archived saved audiences for this organization, including status, saved count and campaign_id (null when the audience is in no campaign). Use to find an audience_id before get_audience, recount_audience, or delivery; pass a limit of 1–100. Pass campaign_id to list one campaign's audiences, or unlinked=true for audiences in no campaign (not both). A filtered page can hold fewer than limit audiences — keep following next_cursor until it is null. Requires 'discovery' scope.

campaign_id.description: Only audiences linked to this campaign (newest link first). Use list_campaigns to find campaign IDs.

compact.description: Return small summaries by default. Use the matching get tool for a complete definition, or compact=false for full entries.

include_archived.description: Include archived objects so they can be found and restored

limit.description: Maximum number of audiences to return (default 10; maximum 100)

unlinked.description: When true, only audiences that belong to no campaign. Do not combine with campaign_id.

name: list_audiences

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

total.description: Number of audiences on this page

title: List Audiences
